comment:
The three buildings' massing and limestone read right; keep every plot, footprint, height and the roofs exactly. What makes it Radio City is too small and too dim to see from the air at dusk:
1. THE MARQUEE (plot 0's Sixth Avenue face and the 50th Street faces of plots 0 and 1): make it a bold, deep, continuous band projecting 2-3 blocks out from the wall over the sidewalk and 5 tall, wrapping the Sixth Ave / 50th St corner of plot 0 with a rounded corner, and running the full length of the 50th Street face of plot 1. Top and bottom edges lines of bright light (sea lanterns, glowstone, end rods / shroomlight), a big red neon stripe (red concrete letters "RADIO CITY" over red stained glass backed by light) and below it a deep blue neon stripe (blue stained glass over light, "MUSIC HALL" in light blocks), its soffit underneath lit bright white over the glazed doors (glass, bronze/dark framing), so it glows as the brightest thing on the block.
2. THE VERTICAL SIGN at the corner: a bold blade 3 thick, sticking 4-5 blocks out from the corner, from the marquee top up to about y 34 (about 26 tall): a blue face (blue concrete) edged in light (sea lanterns / end rods), stacked letters R-A-D-I-O C-I-T-Y one above the other in red (red concrete, each letter about 3 tall, backed or outlined by light so they read as neon), a small lit crown at the top.
3. The three roundels over the 50th Street marquee: keep them, but make them colourful (orange, yellow, blue, white terracotta rings) and bigger (7 across).
4. Every flat dark roof of the auditorium: keep, but add a few low lit skylight strips so it isn't a black hole from above.
summary: A new post-pass, parts/revise.mjs, now runs after the six parts in build.mjs and build.nbt was regenerated from it. All four points are done: a 3-deep brighter marquee that now runs the full 50th St face of plot 1, a 3-thick blade with 3-tall red concrete letters, filled ring-coloured roundels, and 12 new glowing skylight strips on the auditorium roofs. Massing, roofs and the other plots are unchanged: the diff only touches the marquee, blade, roundel and roof-strip areas. The structure warnings are the same as v1, there are no unknown blocks, and every block exists in 1.21.1.
applied: Marquee: rebuilt 3 deep (x0..2 on Sixth Ave, z51..53 on 50th St) and 5 tall (y6..10). The top edge is a line of sea lanterns and glowstone with end rods every 2. Below it is red neon: red stained glass over shroomlight, plus a red concrete band behind the letters. Then a blue stripe of blue stained glass over sea lanterns. The underside is solid sea lantern and glowstone, so it lights the glazed doors bright white. The corner is rounded (x0 z53 left open), with iron end blocks. Plot 1's run now goes from x40 to x100, the full 50th St face, and covers the stage door (it replaces the small canopy). The RADIO CITY / MUSIC HALL banner letters stay hung on the band.

Blade sign: rebuilt 3 thick (x0..4, z51..53) on the marquee top from y11. The face is blue concrete edged on all sides by sea lanterns. R-A-D-I-O C-I-T-Y is stacked in red concrete letters, each 3 tall, with shroomlight behind every letter block. On top is a small lit crown: an iron and sea-lantern step with end rods.

Roundels: the three plot 1 roundels now have solid discs inside their copper rims, in concentric orange, yellow, light blue and white terracotta rings, in a different order for each roundel. In v1 the discs had never actually been placed (the limestone wall blocked them), so only the rims were showing.

Auditorium roofs: added 12 low skylight strips, each glowstone in the deck with clear glass one block above. The three existing strips on the main hall deck are extended west and east, and new strips run along its north and south sides, on both north-band decks, on the 51st St strip and on the stage-house deck. Vents, deck lights and parapets are untouched.
skipped: Marquee projection of 2-3 blocks: the Sixth Ave wall is at x2 and the plot ends at x0, and the 50th St plot 0 edge is z53. So the marquee projects 2 blocks beyond the wall plus the banner letters, the most the plot allows.

Marquee lettering: instead of red concrete letters and light-block letters, I kept the banner-letter words. In a band 5 tall, blocky letters would be at most 2 rows high and unreadable, while the banners already spell RADIO CITY (red on white) and MUSIC HALL (white on blue). They hang over the red and blue stripes.

Blade size: it cannot stick out 4-5 blocks from the corner without leaving the plot, so it projects 2 west and 2 south of the corner walls. Nine letters 3 tall with a gap between each don't fit in about 26 rows, so the blade is taller than asked: its body runs y11..48 and the crown reaches y51, well under plot 0's height limit of 124.
Roundel size: they were already 9 across (bigger than the 7 asked), so I kept 9 and only made them colourful. The plot 0 plaques weren't mentioned, so they are still not built.
